quote.text: The money is in the follow-up.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls scheduled — check Calendly for any new bookings.
focus: Inbox is dry on prospects again, so the bottleneck is follow-up, not lead volume. Pull the 5 freshest of your 27+ FB leads in GHL and send a direct booking-link message before noon — zero have closed, and unworked leads decay fast.

FB Ads are spending ~$35/day at a $17 CPL and still converting zero. Check ad delivery and the booking funnel for the drop-off point — if forms fill but nobody books, the problem is the offer or follow-up cadence, not the ad.

Outbound is mostly dark: Instantly billing lapsed, LinkedIn paused, Bland never launched. FB group posts auto-fire at 9 AM, so reactivate one outbound channel today — restore Instantly billing or send 10 manual DMs — to stop leaning on a single source.
gmail_summary: No prospect replies or warm conversations. Inbox is routine: a HighLevel receipt ($22.62), an Anthropic receipt, a ClearView billing statement, and newsletters. Nothing urgent.
